cover.headline:
Bigger arms.
[y]2 cable moves.[/y]
That's it.

cutout.alt: Dan in red Muay Thai shorts

moves.name: Cable curl

image.placeholder: Gym, side angle: Dan doing straight-bar cable curls, elbows pinned to his sides, frozen at the top squeeze, full body and the cable stack in frame

cues: Pin your elbows to your sides.
Curl up and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are all the way straight.

moves.name: Tricep pushdown

image.placeholder: Gym, side angle: Dan doing cable tricep pushdowns, elbows pinned, arms locked out at the bottom, standing tall (not leaning over the bar)

cues: Pin your elbows to your sides.
Push down to a full lockout.

recap.title: Screenshot this.
recap.note: 1 warm-up set of 12 to 15, then 2 hard sets of 6 to 10.
recap.text: Add these two and you'll be shocked how fast your arms grow. Save this for your next gym day.
